title: Find and Replace Pattern
description: Given an array of lowercase strings `words` and a lowercase string `pattern`, return a list of all words in `words` (preserving their original order) that match `pattern`. A word matches `pattern` if there exists a bijection (one-to-one and onto mapping) between letters such that replacing every letter `x` in `pattern` with `p(x)` produces the word.
constraints: All characters are lowercase English letters.
hints: Normalize a string by assigning each newly encountered character its first-seen integer ID (0, 1, 2, ...).
Alternatively check forward and backward 26-element mapping arrays for each word against pattern.

examples.explanation: "mee" and "aqq" share the exact (0,1,1) pattern of "abb".
"aba" and "cdc" both follow the (0,1,0) pattern of "xyx".
